text_block_list.text:
With the opening address concluded, the 
Fan Appreciation Festival kicked off 
without a hitch. Symboli Rudolf's big 
moment would come later in the exhibition 
race.

Even if it's an exhibition, it will be as 
serious as the real thing. I'd like you to 
rest your body this morning to prepare, 
but...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
“—I see. So there are too few spectators 
waiting for ‘Carrot Digging’... is that 
it?”

text_block_list.name: Student Council Officer A
text_block_list.text:
Yes, it seems everyone is crowding around 
the Scavenger Hunt being held behind us...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
This affects the morale of all 
participants. What major event is underway 
right now?

text_block_list.name: Student Council Officer A
text_block_list.text:
Um... It says "Cosplay Race." They're 
using the grounds.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Distance-wise, it shouldn't be an issue. 
Alright, let's build a path from there 
straight to "Carrot Digging."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Let us expand the display area of the 
timetable concurrently. I authorize the 
deployment of Team G.

text_block_list.name: Student Council Officer A
text_block_list.text: Understood! Excuse me!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: —...Phew.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Ah... My apologies. Sighing in front of 
others is unbecoming.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Besides, you should feel free to look 
around on your own today.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"The students have all prepared for today. 
I want as many people as possible to enjoy 
it."

Even if you say that, seeing her so 
exhausted she can't even hide it worries 
me.

It was only natural. Between training, 
Student Council duties, and managing the 
event, the burden up to this point had 
simply been too great.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
—Madam President, so this is where you 
were.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Oh, Air Groove. What's the matter?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Regarding the additional equipment order I 
contacted you about earlier, I didn't 
receive a reply, so I came by in person.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
My apologies, I forgot to reply. Those 
details look fine to me. Please proceed.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Understood. Excuse me, then.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Sorry for the trouble, but I'm counting on 
you.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"No, I was careless. Completely unfit to 
be student council president, really."
choice_data_list: Isn't fatigue catching up with you?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Even if that's true, the real cause was 
poor management. It's truly pathetic.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Alright, from here on out, let's tighten 
our focus even more.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
What the audience desires in an exhibition 
race is my overwhelming strength.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Many students who've finished their events 
will come to watch. ...I must deliver a 
run befitting an "Emperor."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Haha, no problem at all.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Now then, I must receive a report in the 
student council room. Please enjoy the Fan 
Appreciation Festival.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...Contrary to the faint anxiety lingering 
within, thanks in part to the student 
council's hard work, the event continued 
to proceed smoothly—

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer
text_block_list.text:
—And now, it's time for the start of the 
Tracen Academy Exhibition Race!

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Naturally, the one to watch is the 
"Emperor" Symboli Rudolf! The crowd's 
anticipation is at its peak to see what 
kind of "dominance" she will display!!

text_block_list.name: Roar of the Crowd
text_block_list.text: Waaaah...! Rudoooolph!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
No one in the audience doubted Symboli 
Rudolf's victory; the only interest was in 
how she would win. And yetâ

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer
text_block_list.text:
“—And here they come down the final 
stretch! But Symboli Rudolf seems to be 
struggling here?!”

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Symboli Rudolf isn't coming yet! Coming up 
from the far outside instead isâ!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Hah... Hah... —

text_block_list.name: Spectator
text_block_list.text:
Wait... What was that run just now...? 
That didn't look like "The Emperor" at 
all.

text_block_list.name: Student Spectator
text_block_list.text:
No way, the President is...? I wonder 
what's gotten into her...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: President...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—The result was an unexpected flop for 
Symboli Rudolf. The crowd's stunned murmur 
at the "Emperor's" blunder refused to die 
down for quite some time...
